description: The same Paris feral pigeon on another day, about 30 cm, vacuum cleaner in the background (xeno-canto XC541143 via Wikimedia Commons)

extractions.what: Tracked the same way (input coo-pitch-analysis, section 3.2): 22 of 23 segments used. The fundamental runs 238 Hz, 296 Hz at the top, 231 Hz. Here the fundamental itself is the loudest partial (92 % of the energy; the second harmonic is 6.9 dB under it), energy-weighted 292 Hz; the loudest partial is 467 Hz at its highest. A note lasts 0.42 s and notes start 1.13 s apart.
extractions.note: The same Paris bird six days later, about 30 cm, a vacuum cleaner running, the bird not seen. It disagrees with the first recording on which partial is loudest: at the same fundamental the two differ by 10 to 12 dB below 250 Hz, cause not separable (recorder low-cut, placement, or the bird).
